statements.subject: user
statements.description: If the user should not have access to such a connection, return "error: connection illegal for this process".
actions: return error: connection illegal for this process

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Any outstanding RECEIVEs should be returned with "error: connection reset" responses.
actions: return outstanding RECEIVEs with error: connection reset

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: All queued SENDs and RECEIVEs should be given "connection reset" notification.
actions: notify all queued SENDs and RECEIVEs with connection reset

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: All queued SENDs and RECEIVEs should be given "connection reset" notification; all segments queued for transmission (except for the RST formed above) or retransmission should be flushed.
statements.post_cond: protocol.state = CLOSED & connection.TCB = null & connection.send_queue = empty
actions: notify all queued SENDs and RECEIVEs with connection reset
flush all segments queued for transmission or retransmission except RST
